title: Errors
description: Status codes the API returns and what to do about them.

sections.title: Error format
paragraphs: Errors are JSON objects with a single error string.

sections.title: Status codes
table: Malformed JSON or a field tokens may not send.
Fix the request; do not retry as-is.
Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired token.
Check the token; mint a new one if it expired.
Resource outside your rooms, or a mismatched Origin header.
Check access, or drop the Origin header.
Stop retrying; re-list to find the id.
Conflict: stale task version, task claimed, agent not accepting messages, or idempotency key reused.
Re-read the resource and decide again.
Fix the field named in the error.
